name: Instinctive Commander
text: In your hero phase, a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of the general that is not in combat can, on a 3+, make a Normal Move.

name: Savage Mauling
text: In any combat phase, an enemy unit in combat with the general can make no Ward rolls for the rest of the turn.

name: Venomite Swarm
text: In any combat phase, an enemy unit in combat with the general may suffer D3 mortal damage while the Venomites token remains (a 1 loses the token and does nothing else).

name: Blessed by the Old Ones
text: If the general is destroyed, at the end of each turn roll a dice: on a 2+ the Sunblood returns on its own anywhere on the battlefield, more than 6" from enemies, and is your general.
